title: Jennie Celebrates Sisterhood on 'Someone to Hold' for Netflix's Steps
summary: Jennie is celebrating sibling love on her new single, 'Someone to Hold.' The Blackpink singer recorded the upbeat track for Steps, a forthcoming Netflix animated film, with producer Justin Tranter. 'After everything that we've been through / The ins and outs, the upside downs and good times too,' she sings on the single. Jennie said she was excited to join the Steps family and that making her first song for an animated film was fun. She loves how much heart and personality the characters have, and she is happy to be a little part of their world. Steps, directed by Alyce Tzue and John Ripa, reworks the classic Cinderella story. Tired of living in Cinderella's shadow, Lilith, voiced by Ali Wong, steals the Fairy Godmother's magic wand and hijacks the Royal Ball with her sister Margot, voiced by Stephanie Hsu. That puts the kingdom under the rule of Priscilla, a villainous schemer voiced by Nikki Glaser. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella, voiced by Amanda Seyfried, to save the kingdom — and, most importantly, their relationship. The film will be available to stream on Netflix on November 20. The soundtrack features four original songs written and produced by Tranter, with additional vocals by Seyfried, Rose Gray, and Emei. Kris Bowers composed the score. Jennie has had a busy year. Last March, she released Ruby, her debut solo EP, through her own record label, Odd Atelier. The 15-track album featured collaborations with Childish Gambino, Doechii, Dominic Fike, Dua Lipa, FKJ, and Kali Uchis. Since then, she reunited with Blackpink for a world tour and a new album, Deadline, released in February with five tracks, including the comeback single 'Jump.' In July, she shared a new solo single, 'Less Than a Lover,' about a relationship somewhere between friendship and romance.
why_it_matters: The film retells a familiar fairy tale from the stepsister's point of view, showing how a story can change when it is told by a different character. It also shows how a pop star's music can help a film reach new audiences.

background_read: Steps is an animated film that retells the classic Cinderella story from a new angle, focusing on Cinderella's stepsister Lilith instead of Cinderella herself.
In the story, Lilith steals the Fairy Godmother's magic wand and takes over the Royal Ball with her sister Margot, which puts the kingdom in danger.
Lilith then has to work together with Cinderella to save the kingdom and repair their sisterly relationship, so the film is really about sibling love and teamwork.
Jennie, a singer from the group Blackpink, recorded the song 'Someone to Hold' for the film to celebrate that bond between sisters.
